_doc: PINE-HOLLOW-REMASTER PH-A2..A4: Pine Hollow's sounds, same format as sfx-jobs.json (gen_sfx_moss.py / gen_sfx.py --jobs sfx-ph-jobs.json). Every family is rendered by MOSS-SoundEffect v2 and Stable Audio 3 Medium; sfx_build.py --jobs ranks both with CLAP, sfx_merge.py --jobs ships the better take. `into`: 'best' = replaces / adds a family in the one merged set public/assets/sfx/best/ (the families Audio.ts already plays: crossbow, animals, footsteps), 'pine-hollow' = public/assets/sfx/pine-hollow/ (Pine Hollow only: the zoned beds ForestAmbience plays, the barks, and the sounds ready for events that do not exist yet). `group`: families that are variations of one thing (the NPCs' barks — CLAP cannot tell one man's grunt from another's —, the footstep surfaces) are not ranked against each other in CLAP, only against everything else. `zone` / `live`: the ForestAmbience zone a bed belongs to, and whether that zone exists in the world today.

crossbowFire.desc: a heavy hunting crossbow firing a bolt
crossbowFire.prompt: A single heavy hunting crossbow shot outdoors in a forest: the trigger latch clicks, the thick string slaps forward with a deep twang and the bolt hisses away. Close, dry, no music.

reload.desc: a crossbow being cranked and cocked with a ratchet
reload.prompt: Cocking a heavy crossbow: a geared cranequin ratchet winds the string back with quick metal clicks and wooden creaks, then the string drops into the latch with a solid click. Close, dry, no music.

boltImpact-wood.desc: an arrow thudding into a tree trunk
boltImpact-wood.prompt: A crossbow bolt thudding hard into the trunk of a pine tree: a sharp woody thunk and the shaft vibrating. A single impact, outdoors, no music.

boltImpact-ground.desc: an arrow stabbing into soft forest ground
boltImpact-ground.prompt: A crossbow bolt stabbing into soft forest floor covered in pine needles and earth: a dull muffled thump with a little crunch of needles. A single impact, outdoors, no music.

boltImpact-flesh.desc: an arrow striking an animal's body
boltImpact-flesh.prompt: A crossbow bolt striking the body of a large animal: a short, heavy, wet thump. A single impact, close, no music.

boltImpact-rock.desc: an arrow glancing off a rock
boltImpact-rock.prompt: A crossbow bolt striking a granite boulder: a sharp stony crack and the bolt clattering and skittering away. A single impact, outdoors, no music.

deer_call.desc: a deer bleating in the forest
deer_call.prompt: A white-tailed deer calling in a pine forest: a short nasal bleat, then another. Natural, a little distance, no music.

deer_snort.desc: a startled deer snorting an alarm
deer_snort.prompt: A startled deer blowing a loud alarm snort through its nose, a sharp whoosh of breath, then a stamp of a hoof. Outdoors, no music.

elk_bugle.prompt: A bull elk bugling across a forest valley at dawn: a high, breathy, rising whistle that holds and breaks, then drops into deep chesty grunts. Natural field recording, no music.

bear_roar.desc: a bear roaring as it charges
bear_roar.prompt: A huge brown bear roaring as it charges: a deep, ragged, bellowing roar with a rasp of breath. Close and powerful, outdoors, no music.

bear_growl.prompt: A brown bear growling low and huffing warnings: a slow, deep, rumbling growl and a couple of chesty huffs. Close, outdoors, no music.

boar_squeal.prompt: A wild boar squealing in pain and anger: a loud, shrill, harsh squeal breaking into grunts. Close, outdoors, no music.

boar_grunt.prompt: A wild boar rooting in the forest: a few deep, snuffling pig grunts and snorts. Close, outdoors, no music.

footstep-litter.desc: a footstep on dry pine needles
footstep-litter.prompt: A single boot footstep on a dry forest floor of pine needles and small twigs: a soft crunch and crackle. Close, one step only, no music.

footstep-planks.desc: a footstep on a wooden cabin floor
footstep-planks.prompt: A single heavy boot footstep on an old wooden cabin floor: a hollow knock of the plank with a faint creak. Close, indoors, one step only, no music.

footstep-mud.prompt: A single boot footstep sinking into thick wet mud at a pond's edge: a squelch and a sucking pull as the boot lifts. Close, one step only, no music.

footstep-rock.prompt: A single boot footstep on a granite rock ledge: a hard gritty scuff and click of the sole on stone. Close, outdoors, one step only, no music.

footstep-wet.desc: a footstep on wet ground in the rain
footstep-wet.prompt: A single boot footstep on soaked, rain-wet forest ground and wet leaves: a soft splat and squish. Close, one step only, no music.

leverCycle.prompt: Working the lever of an old lever-action hunting rifle: the lever snaps down with a metallic clack, the spent brass case tinkles out, and the lever slams back up, closing the action. Close, dry, no gunshot, no music.

leverShot.desc: a hunting rifle gunshot in a forest
leverShot.prompt: A single loud lever-action hunting rifle gunshot fired in an open pine forest: a sharp crack and boom with a short outdoor tail. Close, no music.

leverEcho.desc: a distant gunshot echoing off mountains
leverEcho.prompt: The rolling echo of a rifle shot in a mountain valley: a far-off boom rebounding off rocky ridges and rumbling away into the distance. Wide, outdoors, no music.

longbowDraw.prompt: Drawing a wooden longbow: an arrow slides on the rest, the yew limbs creak and the bowstring stretches tight. Close, quiet, no music.

longbowLoose.prompt: Loosing an arrow from a wooden longbow: the bowstring snaps with a deep thrum and the arrow whooshes away. Close, outdoors, no music.

thrall_call.desc: an eerie creature call echoing through foggy woods
thrall_call.prompt: An eerie, unnatural creature call echoing through a foggy forest at night: a hollow, groaning, wooden moan like a tree splitting slowly, with a wet, breathy rattle. Distant, unsettling, no music.

thrall_groan.desc: a wet, creaking creature groan close by
thrall_groan.prompt: A monstrous forest creature made of wet wood and moss groaning close by: a deep creaking, cracking-bark growl with a gurgling, waterlogged breath. Close, eerie, no music.

thrall_move.desc: creaking wood and squelching moss as a creature moves
thrall_move.prompt: A creature of wet wood and moss moving: stiff creaking of old branches, cracking twigs and the squelch of sodden moss with every heavy step. Close, eerie, no music.

king_bells.desc: small bells chiming and jangling eerily
king_bells.prompt: Dozens of small old bronze bells hung on huge antlers, jangling and chiming as a giant beast tosses its head: an eerie, shimmering, irregular chime that rings out. Outdoors at night, no music.

king_stomp.desc: a giant stomp that shakes the ground and cracks roots
king_stomp.prompt: A giant creature stomping the forest floor: a deep, heavy ground-shaking boom, the crack of roots tearing up out of the earth and soil scattering. Powerful, close, no music.

king_roar.prompt: A colossal, ancient antlered forest beast roaring: a huge, deep, bellowing roar like a giant elk bugle mixed with creaking timber and a hollow wind, echoing through a clearing. Terrifying but majestic, no music.

doorOpen.prompt: An old wooden log-cabin door opening slowly: the iron latch lifts with a clack and the hinges creak long and low. Close, no music.

doorClose.desc: a wooden door closing with a thud
doorClose.prompt: An old wooden log-cabin door swinging shut: a short hinge creak, then a solid wooden thud and the iron latch dropping. Close, no music.

lanternLight.desc: a match striking and a lantern flame catching
lanternLight.prompt: Lighting an oil lantern: a wooden match strikes and flares, the glass chimney clinks open and the wick catches with a soft whoomp of flame. Close, quiet, no music.

lanternCreak.desc: a hanging lantern swinging and creaking
lanternCreak.prompt: A metal lantern hanging from a branch, swinging in the wind: its iron handle creaks and squeaks slowly back and forth. Close, outdoors at night, no music.

zipline.desc: a zipline trolley whizzing down a steel cable
zipline.prompt: Riding a zipline: a metal pulley trolley whirring and whizzing faster and faster down a long steel cable, the cable humming and rattling, wind rushing past. No music.

bed-hollow.desc: wind in pine trees with a woodpecker drumming
bed-hollow.prompt: Ambience of a pine forest clearing by day: a steady breeze sighing through tall pine trees, needles rustling, and a woodpecker drumming on a trunk now and then in the distance, a few far birds. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-pond.desc: frogs croaking by a pond with a loon calling
bed-pond.prompt: Ambience at the edge of a still forest pond: frogs croaking in a chorus, the haunting wail of a loon far across the water, dragonflies buzzing past, gentle water lapping at the reeds. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-cabin.desc: a fire crackling in a fireplace inside a quiet cabin
bed-cabin.prompt: Inside a quiet log cabin: a wood fire crackling and popping softly in a stone fireplace, the logs hissing, the faint wind outside muffled by the walls. Continuous close recording, no music.

bed-creek.prompt: Ambience of a clear forest creek: water babbling and trickling over stones, a steady gentle flow. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-waterfall.desc: a waterfall pouring into a pool
bed-waterfall.prompt: Ambience near a forest waterfall: a steady roar of water falling onto rocks and splashing into a plunge pool. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-mill.desc: a wooden water wheel turning and creaking
bed-mill.prompt: An old wooden water mill: the big water wheel turning slowly, creaking and knocking on its axle, water splashing off the paddles and running in the millrace. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-ridge.desc: strong wind howling over a rocky mountain ridge
bed-ridge.prompt: Ambience on an exposed granite mountain ridge: strong gusting wind howling and whistling over the rocks, a hawk crying far away. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-oldgrowth.desc: a hushed ancient forest with creaking trunks and drips
bed-oldgrowth.prompt: Ambience deep in a hushed ancient old-growth forest: near silence, giant trunks creaking slowly in the wind high above, deep heavy water drops falling from the canopy, a raven far away. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-cave.desc: water dripping in a dark cave
bed-cave.prompt: Ambience inside a dark rocky cave: slow water drips echoing into small pools, a low hollow air rumble. Continuous recording, no music.

bed-night.desc: crickets chirping and an owl hooting at night
bed-night.prompt: Ambience of a pine forest at night: a steady chorus of crickets, an owl hooting now and then, a light breeze in the pines. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-nightfog.desc: eerie far-off creature calls in a foggy night forest
bed-nightfog.prompt: Ambience of a foggy forest at night: an eerie stillness, faint far-off hollow groaning calls of unknown creatures echoing between the trees, a twig snapping in the distance. Unsettling, continuous field recording, no music.

bed-rain-canopy.desc: rain pattering on a forest canopy
bed-rain-canopy.prompt: Ambience of steady rain falling on a dense pine forest canopy: a soft, even hiss of rain on the needles high above and heavy drops dripping down onto the forest floor. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-rain-open.desc: rain falling in an open field
bed-rain-open.prompt: Ambience of steady rain falling in an open clearing: rain hissing and splashing on grass and puddles, close and wide. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-dawn.desc: a dawn chorus of songbirds in a forest
bed-dawn.prompt: Ambience of a pine forest at dawn: a rich dawn chorus of songbirds, thrushes and warblers singing, a light breeze in the pines. Continuous field recording, no music.

bark-ranger-1.desc: a gruff older man saying hmm
bark-ranger-1.prompt: A gruff, weathered older man, a forest ranger, giving a short thoughtful 'hmm' of acknowledgement. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-ranger-2.desc: a gruff older man saying aye
bark-ranger-2.prompt: A gruff, weathered older man with a deep voice saying one word, 'Aye.', calmly. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-ranger-3.desc: an older man grunting in agreement
bark-ranger-3.prompt: A weathered older man grunting a low 'mm-hm' in agreement, deep and tired. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-ranger-4.desc: an older man saying careful in a low warning voice
bark-ranger-4.prompt: A gruff older man saying one word, 'Careful.', in a low, serious warning voice. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-ranger-5.prompt: A weathered older man letting out a long, heavy, weary sigh through his nose. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-ranger-6.desc: an older man saying good in an approving voice
bark-ranger-6.prompt: A gruff older man saying one word, 'Good.', warmly approving, deep voice. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-ranger-7.desc: an older man clearing his throat
bark-ranger-7.prompt: A weathered older man clearing his throat with a rough, gravelly cough before speaking. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-ranger-8.prompt: A gruff older man giving a short, low, dry chuckle. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-miller-1.desc: a cheerful plump man saying oh ho
bark-miller-1.prompt: A cheerful, round-voiced middle-aged miller saying 'Oh-ho!' with a warm laugh in it. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-miller-2.desc: a man humming a happy little tune
bark-miller-2.prompt: A cheerful middle-aged man humming a few notes of a happy little tune to himself, mouth closed. Close voice recording, no music instruments.

bark-miller-3.desc: a man grunting as he lifts a heavy sack
bark-miller-3.prompt: A stout middle-aged man grunting with effort as he heaves a heavy flour sack onto his shoulder, a short 'hup!'. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-miller-4.prompt: A jolly, stout middle-aged man laughing a short, hearty belly laugh. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-miller-5.desc: a friendly man saying hello there
bark-miller-5.prompt: A friendly, round-voiced middle-aged man calling 'Hello there!' warmly. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-miller-6.desc: a man puffing and blowing out his cheeks
bark-miller-6.prompt: A stout middle-aged man puffing out his cheeks and blowing out a tired 'phew'. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-miller-7.desc: a man saying thank you kindly
bark-miller-7.prompt: A warm, round-voiced middle-aged man saying 'Thank you kindly!'. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-miller-8.desc: a man making a worried hmm sound
bark-miller-8.prompt: A stout middle-aged man making a worried, rising 'hmm?' sound. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-trader-1.desc: a sly woman saying well well
bark-trader-1.prompt: A sly, husky-voiced woman trader saying 'Well, well...' with a knowing smile in her voice. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-trader-2.prompt: A husky-voiced woman trader saying one word, 'Deal.', crisply and pleased. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-trader-3.desc: a woman making an interested mmm sound
bark-trader-3.prompt: A husky-voiced woman making a low, interested 'mmm' sound while considering an offer. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-trader-4.prompt: A husky-voiced woman giving a short, soft, amused laugh. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-trader-5.desc: a woman tutting and clicking her tongue
bark-trader-5.prompt: A woman tutting disapprovingly, clicking her tongue twice, 'tsk tsk'. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.

bark-trader-6.prompt: A husky-voiced woman trader beckoning, 'Come, see.', low and inviting. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-trader-7.desc: a woman saying no in a firm voice
bark-trader-7.prompt: A husky-voiced woman trader saying one word, 'No.', firmly and flatly. Close voice recording, no music.

bark-trader-8.prompt: A husky-voiced woman humming a curious, rising 'hm?' as she looks something over. Close voice recording, one sound only, no music.
